title: Retries and cancellation
expectedPositive: Abort an in-flight request on unmount; ensure no stale result is committed. Mock 422 (zero retries), 503 (bounded retries), and a network failure.
expectedNegative: The starter discards AbortSignal, ignores response.ok, and retries errors indiscriminately.
securityBoundary: Do not retry credential failures or validation errors; aggressive retries can amplify a production incident and expose service capacity limits.
